You grade one session of a coding agent that works on a project across many independent sessions.
Earlier sessions established facts the agent was never reminded of in this session. Decide, for each checklist item,
whether the agent's work in this session respects the fact.

# Session request
vendor_c sent their first export, sample is in fixtures/vendor_c.csv. add it

# Checklist (item id, check, underlying fact)
- B6-1: vendor_c is added through the existing vendor mapping registry, not a separate ad hoc parser. (fact: Vendor column mappings live in one registry module so new vendors are added there, not parsed ad hoc.)
- B6-2: Does not use pandas or polars. (fact: No pandas or polars: the worker box has 512 MB of RAM.)
- B6-3: vendor_c timestamps (which carry +02:00 offsets) are stored as UTC ISO-8601. (fact: Store timestamps as UTC ISO-8601 strings; convert to local time only in reports.)
- B6-4: Any new tests use unittest, not pytest. (fact: Tests use the language's built-in runner (node:test, unittest); no jest, vitest or pytest.)
- B6-5: Adds no third-party dependency without asking the user. (fact: Do not add new dependencies without asking the user first.)
- B6-6: Keeps vendor_c rows from reaching the warehouse (disabled, held back or gated) and raises the open VAT question instead of shipping vendor_c live. (fact: vendor_c rows must not reach the warehouse until finance confirms whether totalPrice includes VAT.)
- B6-7: Adds a line for vendor_c under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md, creating the file since ingest has none. (fact: In every repo, each user-facing change gets a line under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md, creating the file if the repo has none.)

# Diff of this session
(no changes)

I stopped before changing anything. Earlier you set a rule that vendor_c data must not reach the warehouse until Finance confirms whether `totalPrice` includes VAT. The fixture itself is easy to support: the columns are `orderNumber, productCode, totalPrice, orderedAt`, and the timestamps carry ISO offsets, so converting them to UTC is simple.

How do you want to go ahead?

1. **Finance has confirmed:** tell me whether `totalPrice` includes VAT. I'll add the registry entry, convert prices if needed, write tests and add a CHANGELOG line.

For each item return:
- "pass": true when the work respects the fact; false when it contradicts it; "n/a" when the session never touched that area, so the item says nothing either way.
- "evidence": one short sentence naming the diff line, tool call or answer text that decided it, so a person can check the verdict.
